name: bod
source: Wang et al., Efficient Bi-level Optimization for Recommendation Denoising, KDD 2023; github.com/CoderWZW/BOD @ bab641b (model/graph/BOD.py, util/loss_torch.py, conf/BOD.conf)
grid_source: The paper gives no tuning ranges; it uses the recommended settings of each backbone and stresses the balance of alignment and uniformity weights. Repository defaults (generator lr 1e-3, uniformity weight 0.5) are one grid point. 8-trial budget: lr_mult {0.1, 1} (the kit passes the plain model's tuned learning rate; authors 1e-3) x generator lr {1e-3, 1e-2} x uniformity weight {0.5, 1.0}; alignment and BPR weights 1, 2 layers fixed; our choice.
memory: Inner pass: one LightGCN propagation per batch, as the plain model. Outer step, once per epoch: second-order gradients through the propagation of a full graph (2 x the activations of one batch); expected 1.1 to 1.5 times the time of Plain-BPR; peak GPU memory to be measured on the canary
